name: system-design-skills
description: A divide-and-conquer wiki of system-design skills. Reason about a design problem one part at a time -- requirements, capacity, APIs, storage, caching, load balancing, messaging, consistency, resilience, delivery, and scaling -- each with generic recipes, cloud-provider variants (AWS/Azure/GCP/Temporal), explicit trade-offs, and failure-mode analysis. Optimizes for reasoning over memorized architectures.

interface.shortDescription: Reason about system design one building block at a time
interface.longDescription: A divide-and-conquer wiki of system-design skills: clarify requirements, estimate capacity, then compose building blocks (APIs, storage, caching, load balancing, messaging, consistency, resilience, delivery, scaling) with explicit trade-offs, failure-mode analysis, cloud-provider variants (AWS/Azure/GCP/Temporal), and a self-contained architecture-diagram renderer.
defaultPrompt: Use the system-design skill to design a URL shortener for 10k writes/sec
Estimate storage and QPS for a chat app with 50M daily users
Should we cache this read-heavy endpoint? Walk me through the trade-offs
